help.title: Quick help
help.select.title: Select tool:
help.select.text: click furniture or text to select, drag to move, drag handles to resize/rotate. Drag wall nodes and ruler ends to reshape.
help.wall.title: Draw walls:
help.wall.text: Wall tool → drag from point to point; keep dragging from the last point to continue. Tap to finish the chain.
help.split.title: Split wall:
help.split.text: Wall tool → click on an existing wall.
help.exterior.title: Exterior wall:
help.exterior.text: right-click a wall to toggle exterior / interior.
help.lengths.title: Wall lengths:
help.lengths.text: “Inside” shows the length of each wall measured inside the room; “Both” adds the outside; “Axis” shows centre-line lengths.
help.measure.title: Ruler:
help.measure.text: drag between two points to measure; ends snap to walls and furniture, Shift keeps the line straight. Measurements stay on the plan; remove them with Erase.
help.text.title: Text:
help.text.text: Text tool → click to add a note; double-click a note to edit it. Furniture labels — text, position, size, bold and colour — are set in the panel under the selected item; “Sizes” shows width × depth in a chosen corner.
help.gaps.title: Free space:
help.gaps.text: with “Gaps” on, the selected item shows the distance to the nearest wall or furniture on each side; less than 60 cm is highlighted. Items snap flush (0 cm) to walls and neighbours when dragged close — hold Alt to place freely.
help.pan.title: Pan / zoom:
help.pan.text: drag empty space (or drag with the right button) to pan, scroll wheel to zoom; on touch screens drag empty space or use two fingers.
help.group.title: Groups:
help.group.text: Ctrl/Shift+click adds or removes an item; Ctrl/Shift+drag on empty space selects with a frame; drag any selected item to move the whole group; Ctrl+A selects everything; arrow keys move the selection by 1 cm (with Shift — 10 cm).
help.walledit.title: Edit walls and rulers:
help.walledit.text: click a wall to change its type, thickness and length, or drag it to move; click a ruler line to change its length or drag it, drag its ends to adjust.
help.snap.title: Snap:
help.keys.title: Keyboard:
help.keys.text: Esc — Select tool; Ctrl+S — quick save; Ctrl+Z / Ctrl+Shift+Z — undo / redo; Ctrl+C / V / X — copy / paste / cut; Delete — remove selected.
